biggest_catch: Payouts are monthly and crypto-only: earnings are paid in Tether (USDT) to a digital wallet between the 1st and 5th of each month — no PayPal, no fast cash.
catches: Crypto-only payout (USDT) — requires a digital wallet and conversion to spend.
Monthly payout window (1st-5th) — up to ~5 weeks wait after a test.
Points system: you earn points per day of testing, converted to dollars at payout.
$10-per-test marketing vs. official $5-$20 range and points mechanics.

c1.evidence: Official TesterMob Terms of Service: 'Testers earn points for every day they test the app for at least 20 minutes. These points are converted to dollars and paid in Tether (USDT) to their digital wallets between the 1st and 5th of each month.'

c2.evidence: Official FAQ: 'On average, testers can earn between $5 to $20 per test. Payments are made in cryptocurrency, such as Tether (USDT).' Concrete per-test pay exists, but monthly crypto-only payout fails the fast-cash bar.

c4.evidence: Monthly payout in USDT only — not payable within days and not cash.

notes: Checked 2026-09-23. TesterMob does pay testers ($5-$20/test per official FAQ) but only in Tether (USDT) crypto, paid monthly between the 1st and 5th.
